resources.string: Openeye uses this service to tell when a Reels, Explore, Shorts, For You or Spotlight screen is open inside Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, TikTok or Snapchat, and to cover the button that leads there with a local overlay. It looks only for the handful of buttons it needs to cover. It never reads what you type, never stores page text, and sends nothing off this device — the app has no internet permission. You can turn it off any time in Settings.
Shows how much of your focus session is left.
